data.name: Srestha
data.gender_notes: Srestha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is at the top or foremost. Often used for someone who is the best or most accomplished in a particular field. The name Srestha carries the meaning “Top, Foremost, Best” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Srestha usually hope their child will grow to embody top, foremost, best and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Srestha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Top, Foremost, Best.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Srestha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

It is a source of inspiration and motivation, urging the person to continue striving for greatness.

It is a reminder of our journey towards self-realization, and the highest achievement - union with the divine. Just as the name symbolizes the external pursuit of becoming the foremost in the physical world, it also signifies the internal quest for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
